description:
Load session context for a project using progressive context loading. Use this for an explicit project reload, or as a startup fallback only when session_bootstrap is unavailable. When session_bootstrap is available, do not substitute this tool for the first-turn bootstrap. Three levels available:
- **quick**: Just the latest project state — keywords and open TODOs (~50 tokens)
- **standard**: Project state plus recent session summaries and decisions (~200 tokens, recommended)
- **deep**: Everything — full session history with all files changed, TODOs, and decisions (~1000+ tokens)

conversation_id.description: Optional. Session key for this conversation (same id used in session_save_ledger). When provided, marks the session as context-loaded server-side so project-scoped tools can verify working context without relying on hook-based enforcement. Required on non-Claude hosts.

level.description: How much context to load: 'quick' (just TODOs), 'standard' (recommended — includes recent summaries), or 'deep' (full history). Omit to use the Prism dashboard's Context Depth setting (safe fallback: standard).

max_tokens.description: Maximum token budget for context response. Uses 1 token ≈ 4 chars heuristic. When set, the response is truncated to fit within the budget. Default: unlimited.

project.description: Project identifier to load context for.

prompt.description: Optional. User prompt text for keyword-triggered skill loading. When provided, the server matches against prompt_keywords in the routing table and loads additional skills. Fires on every call — enables mid-session re-routing when the user's focus changes.

role.description: Optional. Agent role for Hivemind scoping (e.g., 'dev', 'qa', 'pm'). Omit to let the server auto-resolve from dashboard settings. When set, also injects active_team roster.

toolAction.description: Brief 2-5 word summary of what this tool is doing. Capitalize like a sentence.

toolSummary.description: Brief 2-5 word noun phrase describing what this tool call is about.

name: session_load_context
